title: Wayfare Bikes and Scooters Plan Schedule: Prices, Terms and Systems
content:
Wayfare Bikes and Scooters plans are sold in three bike share systems: Denver (DEN), Salt Lake City (SLC) and Phoenix (PHX). The schedule below gives, for each plan, the price of one term in US dollars, the length of one term, and whether the term starts at the first unlock. Every plan price includes applicable taxes.

## Schedule

| Plan | Price of one term (USD, tax included) | Days one term lasts | Term starts at the first unlock after purchase | Systems sold in |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Wayfare Bikes Pay As You Ride | 0.00 | 0 (open-ended account) | No | DEN, SLC, PHX |
| Wayfare Bikes Day Pass | 16.50 | 1 | Yes | DEN, SLC, PHX |
| Wayfare Bikes Monthly Pass | 29.00 | 30 | No | DEN, SLC, PHX |
| Wayfare Bikes Access Annual | 60.00 | 365 | No | DEN, SLC, PHX |
| Wayfare Bikes Annual | 179.00 | 365 | No | DEN, SLC, PHX |
| Wayfare Bikes Annual Plus | 249.00 | 365 | No | DEN, SLC, PHX |

## Notes to the schedule

1. **Price.** The price is the price of the plan for one term. Pay As You Ride is priced at 0.00: it is a free account rather than a paid term.
2. **Term length.** The days one term lasts are counted with the activation date as day 1. A term length of 0 marks an open-ended account; Pay As You Ride has no term end.
3. **Day Pass start.** A Day Pass term starts at the first unlock after purchase, not at purchase. For every plan marked "No" in that column the term runs from activation.
4. **Tax.** Plan prices include applicable taxes; the listed price is the whole price of the term.
5. **Systems.** Every plan is sold in each of the three systems listed.

## Reading the schedule (hypothetical dates)

The dates below are illustrations chosen for this page, not records of any rider.

- A Wayfare Bikes Monthly Pass activated on 10 June counts 10 June as day 1, so day 30, the last day of the term, is 9 July.
- A Wayfare Bikes Annual plan activated on 1 March 2025 counts 1 March 2025 as day 1, so day 365 is 28 February 2026.
- A Wayfare Bikes Day Pass bought on 4 August and first unlocked on 6 August has a one-day term, and that day is 6 August, the day of the first unlock.
- A Wayfare Bikes Pay As You Ride account opened on any date has no last day of term.
